title: aw-intake and aw-build, reproduction committed
source: #55: the fast build commits a bug's reproduction as a test when the seam answer takes the seam it exercises (#114, #119)
command: /ai-workflow:aw-intake Un socio devolvió un libro el mismo día del vencimiento y le cobraron 25 céntimos. Por ejemplo, un préstamo con vencimiento 2026-10-15 devuelto ese día: GET /members/<socio>/fees da 25 y debería dar 0.

answers.when: Which base to branch from or diff against
answers.reason: only asked if the remote and local main differ

answers.when: Which seam to test the due-day fee at
answers.intent: A unit test of lateFeeCents, next to the existing ones in tests/fees.test.ts; when it also proposes the seam the reproduction exercises, the fees endpoint, take that seam too
answers.reason: taking the reproduction's seam makes the build commit the reproduction as a test instead of deleting it, the path aw-fast-build never takes (#114); the answer leaves it to the build to propose that seam

turns.reason: the route's next skill, with intake's report still in the conversation

assertions.name: the reproduction is a committed test outside .aw/

assertions.judge: Intake classified it fast, reproduced the bug first through the fees endpoint and stated 1 to 3 observable Done when criteria
The seam question offered the fees endpoint the reproduction exercises, with one line on what it catches and what it misses, and the agreed seams kept it
The build moved the reproduction to where the project keeps its tests at the fees endpoint seam and committed it in the build's commit; the report names it as committed, not as deleted
Named /aw-review as the next skill and not /aw-verify, since the repo has no verify skill
